photos.desc: Diaea dorsata, female. Taken in Mannheim in the Sandhofer Wald, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
A crab spider from the species Diaea dorsata as found in the Rhine-Taunus Nature Park , Hesse, Germany.
With an air of greatness, this little crap spider is shown among the stones
